label: Cluster reassessment of the sustaining, Dei Filius bridge and dependence premises (eternity path)
summary: Issue #1751 model-trial slice 2/3 reassessment of the eternity-dependence cluster fixed in docs/eternity-dependence-connection.md, drafted on main ebd3c2394a40eeae1bfc7fd9b0824d88e3bba887. The nine legacy-only GOD_4-route premises that are targets of attempts citing that note by path (05bc2722, 76bad0cb, dee1c25e) were all still legacy_only at this baseline, so the counted scope is unchanged: sub-route A sustaining and concurrent actualization (23e04ae5, 76d2cc96, d7f5a528, c4661518, 140544c4), sub-route B old Dei Filius bridges (c7c32f20, fa3f08a8, which only link the note; their evidence is in b93ce632, 76bad0cb, d9c2b200, 0da0dd9e and the modal-spine immensity paragraphs), and sub-route C dependence premises (732302a1, 96d25c42, with evidence in the underived-essence, power-existence and support-formula notes). Route nodes 40a97664 and ce55210c are named because sub-route A cannot be assessed without its crux; their recorded judgments are restated unchanged. Dossier and brief retrieved for each target, consumers and producers computed from the corpus, every attempt on each target and the cited note sections read. No argument concludes any of the nine. Three first grades: 140544c4 strong prima facie for its selected-history instance only, its all-histories scope (which result 0ed3a583 consumes) resting on an unrecorded reading choice about the unindexed InAct and left unassessed; c4661518 moderate prima facie; 732302a1 strong as a source-internal reading of q.44 a.1 (claim 11b0106d through supports relation 6094905c), with its application to an assigned Participates and to a present sustaining cause not warranted by that reading. Everything else restates earlier records: 40a97664 unresolved against extrinsic existential inertia, each side's rationale assuming what the other denies; d7f5a528 open with no warrant on file (q.105 a.5 unread, blocker retained); ce55210c conditional on 40a97664, d7f5a528 and the unassessed da72ae93; 23e04ae5 and the presence component of c7c32f20 no better supported than those; 76d2cc96 no standing above 40a97664; c7c32f20 and fa3f08a8 positively motivated by read but unpinned source leads and ungraded because a3913182, 18ca6f9d and bbac932e are unassessed; 96d25c42 unchanged from the reviewed 2026-11-11 judgment issued for its concrete instance dd41c165, the same predicate instantiated (independently OPEN commitment, not a consequence of de re necessity plus local foundation); its own source-interface next step is retained. Objections and rivals, 18 rows: kept 2 (extrinsic existential inertia as a substantive undercutting objection with one classification across all its targets; replaceable realization against 96d25c42 and dd41c165); restated 6; boundary retained 5; no substantive objection identified 4; rejected support routes retained 1. Countermodels and controls restated as facts about one formal interpretation each. Eternity, sempiternity, aevum, temporal everlastingness, the Boethian typed reading and the timelessness of the conserving action are kept distinct; none of the named statements contains Eternal and no eternity conclusion is drawn. Originating and sustaining causation, and temporal beginning and creation from nothing, are kept distinct. The sustaining route reaches GOD_4 only through an already named God; 732302a1 lies on pre-naming existence routes (5c5b794f to 09c6d5f0 in bundle 5e8e6054; 2162ca9d to c71c068c) but its grade does not reach its application there, so no independent existence warrant is added. The two 2026-11-17 sections of the note were delivered and reviewed in PR-1709 (merged at bbf1ce941e72dc3979ab5fc25d8db0b07a0652fc); their substantive outcomes are kept. No theorem, Challenge, claim, definition, closure or formal status changed. No revision is declared; every earlier judgment is kept. The #1736 integration scope is not duplicated. Repair after the coordinator's independent semantic challenge of d9f76da8f43864da28ac81ca3301ccd7e0609a23 (2 P1, 9 P2): the PR-1709 review and merge record is cited; the 140544c4 grade is confined to the selected-history instance; the dd41c165 relation, inertia's direct reach to 732302a1 on a sustaining reading and to 16828262, the single derivation b25dbaad of da72ae93, the scope of the #1626 judgment, the aevum records, the created-intellect vacuity caveat and the first-time non-weighting of the persistence-power rival are corrected.
blocker: Formalize the restriction recorded and not formalized in 05bc2722: concurrence only for a cause of the being of everything else. Test whether the presence step 9469ab62 still follows from it with da72ae93, 40a97664, 140544c4 and c4661518, or find the exact obstacle. Success registers a premise weaker than d7f5a528 (strength rule #1017) and removes the relay lead from the route; failure shows the route needs concurrence for arbitrary causes of being. It does not touch the crux 40a97664, which moves only on an independently justified standing-dependence account or no-inducer scope evidence. 96d25c42's own next step from the source-interface section is retained unchanged: stop that line until independent evidence discriminates universal essential dependence from switching support, or justifies the two source interfaces and their world scope.

current_assessment.scope: Eternity-dependence cluster (docs/eternity-dependence-connection.md): the sustaining and concurrent-actualization route to the immensity presence step, the two old Dei Filius bridges that link it, and the participation and no-contingent-support dependence premises. Covers the nine legacy-only premises 23e04ae5, 76d2cc96, d7f5a528, c4661518, 140544c4, c7c32f20, fa3f08a8, 732302a1 and 96d25c42, and route nodes 40a97664 and ce55210c. The #1736 eternity integration is out of scope.
current_assessment.assessment: On the fixed meanings of GivesAt (strict esse-giving), inclusive presence, originating versus sustaining causation and reception-in versus origin-from, the conservation reading behind the sustaining route is a coherent, positively motivated conditional account whose crux, weak concurrent actualization 40a97664, is unresolved against extrinsic existential inertia: each side's recorded rationale assumes what the other denies, and the shared causal requirement on cessation favors neither. ce55210c, 23e04ae5, 76d2cc96 and the presence component of c7c32f20 are no better supported than that crux together with concurrence d7f5a528 (no warrant on file), the unassessed reception bridge da72ae93 and, for the presence step, the unassessed all-histories scope of 140544c4. The calibration premises carry no recorded substantive objection: c4661518 is moderate prima facie, and 140544c4 is strong prima facie for its selected-history instance only, its all-histories scope resting on an unrecorded reading choice about the unindexed InAct and left unassessed (first grades). c7c32f20 and fa3f08a8 are positively motivated by read but unpinned source leads and ungraded, their finer premises a3913182, 18ca6f9d and bbac932e being unassessed. 732302a1 is strong as a source-internal reading of q.44 a.1 (first grade); that reading warrants neither its application to contingent concreta (ff8ff869, unassessed) nor a present sustaining cause. 96d25c42 keeps the reviewed 2026-11-11 standing issued for its concrete instance dd41c165, as an independently open commitment with a kept replaceable-realization rival. No eternity conclusion and no independent warrant for GOD_4's existence is supplied: the sustaining route reaches GOD_4 only after naming, and 732302a1, though on pre-naming existence routes, has a grade that does not reach its application there. Nothing is established or defeated.
